items.label: Sysgration IR presentation: 4Q25 Investor Conference (03-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Drones (company): Sysgration has acted as a distributor for Quantum Systems

set.signal: Drones (company): Sysgration has acted as a distributor for Quantum Systems products since 4Q25; under the partnership it will play a strategic localized role, responsible for exclusive sales, manufacturing, joint procurement, product lifecycle support and maintenance training for the entire Quantum Systems product line (including short-, medium- and long-range AI ISR drones) in Taiwan, promoting localized manufacturing of uncrewed aerial systems (UAS); it has achieved 100% MIT (Made in Taiwan) localized manufacturing for drones and is successively receiving customer inquiries; ground control station (GCS) products are expected to ramp up in 2H26.

items.reason: The deck states the exclusive Taiwan sales / manufacturing / support role as a forward-looking one ('will play'); the entry wrote it as already in place. Only the distributor role since 4Q25 is stated as current.
items.evidence: Sysgration will play a strategic localized role, responsible for exclusive sales, manufacturing, joint procurement, product lifecycle support, and maintenance training for the entire Quantum Systems product line
